<p style="margin: 0px 0pt; text-align: right; font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Exhibit 99.1</b></font></p>

<p style="margin: 0px 0pt; text-align: left; font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: right; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt;"><img alt="logo01.jpg" src="logo01.jpg"></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 14pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: center;"><br>
<b>Usio Announces Second&nbsp;Quarter&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20229311667217498304">2026</a>&nbsp;Financial Results</b></p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 14pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: center;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 12pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: center; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">Revenue, Earnings per Share, and Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup>&nbsp;beat Consensus Estimates</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 12pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: center; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 12pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: center; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">Revenue up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x4" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="27" id="led128743F20264111778502586684">19%</a>, Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup> up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x4" data-tblname="128747" data-tblv="27" id="led128747F2026771786127513162">128%</a></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 12pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: center; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 12pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: center; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">Raises Fiscal 2026 Revenue Guidance, Revenues Now Expected to be up 14-16%</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:center;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;"><i>Total payment dollars processed through all payment channels up <a data-tblloc="12x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="27" id="led64715F20249241729770375162">27%</a></i></p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:12pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:center;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 14pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: center;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">SAN ANTONIO, August 12, <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>&nbsp;(GLOBE NEWSWIRE) &#8211; Usio, Inc., "Usio" or the "Company"&nbsp;(Nasdaq: USIO), a leading FinTech company&nbsp;that operates a full stack of integrated, cloud-based electronic payment and embedded financial solutions, today announced financial results for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">second</a>&nbsp;quarter&nbsp;ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20229311667218799775">June 30, 2026</a>.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Louis Hoch, President and Chief Executive Officer of Usio, said,&nbsp;&#8220;The second quarter built upon a record start to the new year, with all of our key performance indicators showing sustained growth.&nbsp;I am particularly pleased with our bottom line, which we have been intently focused on improving, where Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup> was up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x4" data-tblname="128747" data-tblv="27" id="led128747F2026761786024610114">128%</a> from a year ago and GAAP net income was approximately <a data-tblloc="12x1" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="27" id="led128743F2026761786024696590">$0.3</a>&nbsp;million, or $0.01 per share.&nbsp;Revenue growth accelerated sequentially from the first quarter, up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x4" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20264111778499697479">19%</a>&nbsp;versus the prior year period with all of Card, ACH and Output Solutions generating over 20% growth in the quarter.&nbsp;Total processing&nbsp;transactions set new records, led by&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="27" id="led64715F2026761786024799694">34%</a>&nbsp;transaction growth in ACH during the quarter. Our financial condition and liquidity remain strong.&nbsp;Consequently, based on our extremely strong first half of the fiscal year and confidence in our new business opportunities, we have raised our expectations for our top line growth,&nbsp;with full year revenues now expected to be up 14 to 16%&nbsp;compared to the prior year, an increase from the previously expected 10 to 12%.&#8221;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Results in the second quarter were led by a&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="3x4" data-tblname="64716" data-tblv="27" id="led64716F20264111778499944735">28%</a> increase in credit card revenues where volumes were up strongly, with dollars processed up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="27" id="led64715F20233281682686143924">13%</a> and transactions processed&nbsp;up <a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="27" id="led64715F20233281682686149539">19%</a> from a year ago. PayFac revenues were up 43% in the quarter and continue to comprise over three quarters of credit card revenues, which has precipitated the inflection in credit card's&nbsp;growth trajectory.&nbsp;ACH, our highest margin business, had another record quarter. Revenues were up <a data-tblloc="2x4" data-tblname="64716" data-tblv="27" id="led64716F20264111778500247721">21%</a> on record transaction volume, which was up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="27" id="led64715F20233281682686181716">34%</a>, and as the result of our growing RTP business and strong PINless debit growth. Further penetration of the mortgage servicing and fintech industries as well as the addition of new accounts continues to fuel ACH growth.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Output Solutions had an outstanding quarter, with&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x4" data-tblname="64716" data-tblv="27" id="led64716F20264111778500317494">22%</a> revenue growth in the second quarter of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>&nbsp;over the same period last year, sequentially improving from 19% in the previous quarter. Volumes were at record levels with electronic documents processed and delivered up 49% and total pieces printed and mailed&nbsp;up 43%.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">For the quarter, gross profits were up over 11%, with gross margins at 24% in the quarter, a sequential improvement from 20% in the first quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>. Gross margins were down nominally versus the prior year period, primarily attributable to a decrease in interest revenue (which has a 100% margin) and revenue mix. Total selling, general and administrative expenses,&nbsp;inclusive of depreciation and amortization and stock-based compensation ("Total SG&amp;A Expenses"),&nbsp;were down approximately $190,000 from the year ago period, while&nbsp;"SG&amp;A," consisting of selling, general and administrative expenses only,&nbsp;was down nominally at 1% from the year ago quarter.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">For the quarter ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F2025711754077622272">June 30, 2026</a>, the Company reported net income of approximately&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="12x1" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="27" id="led128743F20264111778500787276">$0.3</a> million, or&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="14x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785326424855">$0.01</a>&nbsp;per share, compared to a net loss of (<a data-tblloc="13x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785326434105">$0.4</a>) million, or (<a data-tblloc="14x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785326440954">$0.01</a>) per share, for the second quarter of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F2026441777896755185">2025</a>. Note that there were no extraordinary items that contributed to the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">second</a> quarter <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>&nbsp;net income as calculated in accordance with United States generally accepted accounting principles ("GAAP").&nbsp;Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup>&nbsp;was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="128747" data-tblv="27" id="led128747F20264111778500961816">$1.1</a> million for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">second</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, more than double the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x2" data-tblname="128747" data-tblv="27" id="led128747F20264111778500969542">$0.5</a> million in the same quarter a year ago.&nbsp;The Company used approximately $371,000 to repurchase 281,000 shares of its common stock in the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="27" id="led64488F20229311667218235799">six months ended June 30, 2026</a>.&nbsp;Cash was in excess of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64712" data-tblv="27" id="led64712F2026761786025407436">$6.4</a>&nbsp;million at&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20264111778520969208">June 30, 2026</a>, down over the six months,&nbsp;with&nbsp;the decrease being related to some annual cash outlays&nbsp;occurring in the period. In addition, cash was used for leasehold improvements and integration of our new Output Solutions printer in the second quarter, which helped accelerate Output Solutions revenues.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><b><u>Quarterly Processing and Transaction Volumes</u></b></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Total payment dollars processed through all payment channels in the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">second</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a> were&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="10x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="27" id="led64715F2024771723062386146">$2.47</a> billion, an increase of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="12x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="27" id="led64715F2024771723062368254">27%</a> over the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="10x2" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="27" id="led64715F2024771723062396886">$1.94</a> billion processed in last year's <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">second</a> quarter.&nbsp;Total payment transactions processed in the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">second</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>&nbsp;were 17.9 million, an increase&nbsp;of 27% over the same quarter of last year.&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Our credit card segment continues to grow, where dollars processed in the second quarter of 2026 were up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="27" id="led64715F20233281682686143924">13%</a> and transactions processed were up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="27" id="led64715F20233281682686149539">19%</a> from the year ago quarter. In the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">second</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, ACH electronic check transaction volume was&nbsp;up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="27" id="led64715F20233281682686181716">34%</a>, setting a new quarterly transaction record for the fifth consecutive quarter, while&nbsp;electronic check dollars processed were up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="27" id="led64715F20233281682686188862">28%</a> and return check transactions processed were up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="27" id="led64715F20233281682686195815">35%</a>, in each case, compared to the same quarter of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F2026441777896755185">2025</a>. In our&nbsp;prepaid card services business unit,&nbsp;card load volume was flat, and transactions processed were down&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="8x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="27" id="led64715F20233281682686164394">4%</a>;&nbsp;however, purchase volume&nbsp;was up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="9x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="27" id="led64715F20233281682686172563">11%</a>&nbsp;for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">second</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, in each case, compared to the same quarter of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20259281761652517712">2025</a>.&nbsp;Output Solutions pieces processed and mailed were up 43% while electronic documents processed and delivered were up 49% for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">second</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, in each case, compared to the same quarter of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20259281761652517712">2025</a>.</p>

<p style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><u><b><a data-tblloc="44x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20229311667217657196">Second</a>&nbsp;Quarter&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20229311667217666159">2026</a>&nbsp;Revenue Detail</b></u></p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">Revenues for the quarter ended&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20229311667217678779">June 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;were&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20229311667217706070">$23.7</a>&nbsp;million, up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x4" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20264111778499697479">19%</a> from&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20251061762436943817">$20.0</a>&nbsp;million in the prior year quarter, due to increases in all of our business lines, excluding prepaid card services. Interest revenues were also lower.&nbsp;Revenues for the six months ended&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20229311667217678779">June 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;were&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x5" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785326874475">$49.1</a>&nbsp;million, up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x8" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785326881280">17%</a>&nbsp;from&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x6" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785326887936">$42.0</a>&nbsp;million in the prior year period, once again due&nbsp;to increases in all of our business lines, excluding prepaid card services, and lower interest revenues.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">Gross profit&nbsp;for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">second</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a> was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20229311667217861249">$5.7</a>&nbsp;million, up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x4" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F2026761786025749388">11%</a> versus&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F2026441777896860687">$5.1</a> million in the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">second</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686978409">2025</a>. Gross margins (defined as gross profit as a percentage of total revenues)&nbsp;were&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20229311667217868890">24.2%</a>&nbsp;in&nbsp;the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">second</a> quarter of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, down versus&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F2026441777896904375">25.8%</a>&nbsp;in the second quarter of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20251061762437050109">2025</a>. This was&nbsp;primarily due to lower interest revenues, a high margin revenue source, and revenue mix.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">Gross profit&nbsp;for the <a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="27" id="led64488F20266291785326935264">six months ended June 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x5" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785326946146">$10.9</a>&nbsp;million, up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x8" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F2026761786027130290">9%</a> versus&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x6" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785326951840">$9.9</a>&nbsp;million in the first half&nbsp;of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686978409">2025</a>. Gross margins were&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x5" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785326960848">22.1%</a>&nbsp;in&nbsp;the first half&nbsp;of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, down versus&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x6" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785326967118">23.7%</a>&nbsp;in the first half of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20251061762437050109">2025</a>. This was&nbsp;primarily due to lower interest revenues, a high margin revenue source, and revenue mix.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">Total SG&amp;A Expenses for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">second</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>&nbsp;were&nbsp;$5.3 million, down from&nbsp;$5.5 million in the year ago quarter primarily due to lower depreciation&nbsp;and amortization expense.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">Total SG&amp;A Expenses for the <a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="27" id="led64488F20266291785326935264">six months ended June 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;were&nbsp;$10.3&nbsp;million, down from $10.6&nbsp;million in the comparable year ago period primarily due to lower depreciation&nbsp;and amortization.&nbsp;SG&amp;A was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="6x5" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785327141540">$8.9</a>&nbsp;million for the first half of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a> compared to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="6x6" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785327149812">$8.8</a>&nbsp;million in the comparable prior year period. This nominal&nbsp;increase in SG&amp;A was primarily related to increases in salary&nbsp;alongside&nbsp;increases in network infrastructure&nbsp;and&nbsp;professional fees that occurred in the first quarter of 2026.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">For the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">second</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, we reported&nbsp;operating income of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="9x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20236311690828878985">$0.4</a>&nbsp;million&nbsp;compared to an operating loss of (<a data-tblloc="9x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F2024721722602768544">$0.4</a>) million for the same quarter a year ago, primarily due to increased revenues and gross profits, alongside a decrease in Total SG&amp;A Expenses. Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup>&nbsp;was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="16x1" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="27" id="led128743F20229311667217955432">$1.1</a>&nbsp;million for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">second</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, compared to&nbsp;Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup>&nbsp;of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="17x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F2024491715262601824">$0.5</a>&nbsp;million for the same quarter a year ago. Net income in&nbsp;the quarter ended&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20237101691688231954">June 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;was approximately <a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20236311690828900390">$0.3</a>&nbsp;million, or <a data-tblloc="14x1" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="27" id="led128743F20229311667218004520">$0.01</a>&nbsp;per share, compared to a net loss of (<a data-tblloc="13x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F2024721722602807883">$0.4</a>) million, or (<a data-tblloc="14x2" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="27" id="led128743F20229311667218064431">$0.01</a>) per share,&nbsp;for the same period in the prior year.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">For the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="27" id="led64488F20266291785326935264">six months ended June 30, 2026</a>, we reported&nbsp;operating income of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="9x5" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785327211728">$0.6</a>&nbsp;million&nbsp;compared to an operating loss of (<a data-tblloc="9x6" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785327217691">$0.6</a>) million for the same period&nbsp;a year ago, primarily due to increased revenues and gross profits, alongside a decrease in Total SG&amp;A Expenses. Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup>&nbsp;was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="17x5" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785327233690">$1.9</a>&nbsp;million for the <a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="27" id="led64488F20266291785326935264">six months ended June 30, 2026</a>, compared to&nbsp;Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup>&nbsp;of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="17x6" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785327250525">$1.2</a>&nbsp;million for the same period a year ago. Net income in&nbsp;the <a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="27" id="led64488F20266291785326935264">six months ended June 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;was approximately <a data-tblloc="13x5" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785327261072">$0.4</a>&nbsp;million, or <a data-tblloc="14x5" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785327273416">$0.01</a>&nbsp;per share, compared to a net loss of (<a data-tblloc="13x6" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785327285705">$0.6</a>) million, or (<a data-tblloc="14x6" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="27" id="led64711F20266291785327293970">$0.02</a>) per share,&nbsp;for the same period in the prior year.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">Operating Cash Flows&nbsp;declined to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="64713" data-tblv="27" id="led64713F20229311667218268164">$0.3</a>&nbsp;million for the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="27" id="led64488F20229311667218235799">six months ended June 30, 2026</a>, as compared to <a data-tblloc="2x2" data-tblname="64713" data-tblv="27" id="led64713F20229311667218356250">$1.1</a>&nbsp;million in the same period a year ago. The year ago period benefited from an approximately $1.5 million tax refund. Additionally,&nbsp;accounts receivable at&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="27" id="led64488F20229311667218448700">June 30, 2026</a> was up as compared to December 31, 2025, reflecting our strong revenue growth.</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">We believe we continue&nbsp;to be in solid financial condition.&nbsp;Cash and cash equivalents as of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="27" id="led64488F20229311667218448700">June 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;were <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64712" data-tblv="27" id="led64712F20229311667218437285">$6.4</a> million, a&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x3" data-tblname="64712" data-tblv="27" id="led64712F20233281682685994931">$1.0</a> million decrease over cash and cash equivalents as of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="25x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20264111778521304283">December 31, 2025</a>, due to items occurring once annually such as payment of state taxes&nbsp;and insurance, alongside some one-time cash outlays related to leasehold improvements and integration of our new Output Solutions printer in the second quarter. This was in addition to the use of over $371,000&nbsp;to repurchase 281,000 shares of our common stock during the <a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="27" id="led64488F20229311667218235799">six months ended June 30, 2026</a>.</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><u><b>Conference Call and Webcast</b></u></p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Usio's management will host a conference call on Wednesday, August 12, <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, at 4:30 pm Eastern time&nbsp;to review financial results and provide a business update.&nbsp;To listen to the conference call, interested parties within the&nbsp;U.S.&nbsp;should call +1-844-833-3890. International callers should call&nbsp;+&nbsp;1-412-317-9246. All callers should ask for the Usio conference call. The conference call will also be available through a live webcast, which can be accessed via the Company&#8217;s website at&nbsp;www.usio.com/investors.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">A replay of the call will be available approximately one hour after the end of the call through September&nbsp;12, <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="27" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>. The replay can be accessed via the Company&#8217;s website or by dialing 1-855-669-9658 (U.S.) or&nbsp;1-412-317-0088&nbsp;(international). The replay conference playback code is 8298156.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><u><b>About Usio, Inc.</b></u></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Usio, Inc.&nbsp;(Nasdaq:&nbsp;USIO), a leading, cloud-based, integrated FinTech electronic payment solutions provider, offers a wide range of payment solutions to merchants, billers, banks, service bureaus, integrated software vendors and card issuers. The Company operates credit, debit/prepaid, and ACH payment processing platforms to deliver convenient, world-class payment solutions and services to clients through its unique payment facilitation platform as a service. The Company, through its Usio Output Solutions division, offers services relating to electronic bill presentment, document composition, document decomposition and printing and mailing services. The strength of the Company lies in its ability to provide tailored solutions for card issuance, payment acceptance, and bill payments as well as its unique technology in the card issuing sector.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">Usio&nbsp;is headquartered in&nbsp;San Antonio, Texas, and has offices in&nbsp;Austin, Texas. Websites:&nbsp;www.usio.com&nbsp;and&nbsp;www.akimbocard.com.&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">Find us on LinkedIn, Facebook&#174; and Twitter.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><u><b>Comparisons</b></u></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Unless otherwise indicated, all comparisons and growth rates represent year-over-year comparisons, with the quarterly period of this year compared to the corresponding quarter of the prior year.</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><u><b>About Non-GAAP Financial Measures</b></u></p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">This press release&nbsp;includes the non-GAAP financial measures, as defined in Regulation G adopted by the Securities and Exchange Commission, of EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA, and Adjusted EBITDA margins. The Company reports its financial results in compliance with GAAP, but believes that also discussing non-GAAP financial measures is useful to investors because it provides them with financial measures the Company uses in the management of its business.</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; width: 100%;">

		<tr>
			<td style="width: 29px; padding: 0px; text-align: center; vertical-align: top;">&#8226;</td>
			<td style="width: 1687px;">The Company defines EBITDA as operating income (loss), before interest income, interest expense, taxes, depreciation and amortization of intangibles.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td style="width: 29px; padding: 0px; text-align: center; vertical-align: top;">&#8226;</td>
			<td style="width: 1687px;">The Company defines Adjusted EBITDA as EBITDA, as defined above, plus non-cash stock-based compensation and certain non-recurring items, such as costs related to acquisitions.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td style="width: 29px; padding: 0px; text-align: center; vertical-align: top;">&#8226;</td>
			<td style="width: 1687px;">The Company defines Adjusted EBITDA margins as Adjusted EBITDA, as defined above, divided by total revenues.</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Management believes presenting EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA, and Adjusted EBITDA margins&nbsp;is helpful to investors in evaluating the Company's operating performance because non-cash costs and other items that management believes are not indicative of its results of operations are excluded.&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt;">EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA, and Adjusted EBITDA margins should be considered in addition to, not as a substitute for, or superior to, financial measures calculated in accordance with GAAP.&nbsp;They are not&nbsp;measurements of our financial performance under GAAP and should not be considered as alternatives to revenue,&nbsp;net income, or cash provided by (used in) operating activities, or any other performance measures derived in accordance with GAAP and may not be comparable to other similarly titled measures of other businesses. EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA, and Adjusted EBITDA margins have&nbsp;limitations as analytical tools and you should not consider these non-GAAP financial measures in isolation or as&nbsp;substitutes for analysis of our operating results as reported under GAAP.</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>
